action_summary: Reverted the image normalization to ImageNet statistics (mean [0.485,0.456,0.406], std [0.229,0.224,0.225]), which produced the best historical score (0.96062) and which the public resnet200d checkpoints were trained with; all later normalization tweaks lost score. Added an ensemble over every .pth checkpoint found in the resnet200d-baseline-benchmark-public dataset (falling back to the single fold4 file), with a robust state-dict loader (handles 'module.' prefixes and wrapped dicts). Added multi-scale TTA averaging predictions at 512 and 640 on top of the existing horizontal-flip TTA, and reduced batch size to 64 for memory headroom at 640. Removed the irrelevant *100 output scaling; the submission format is unchanged.
